facts.business: Ashish Polyplast Limited manufactures and sells PVC pipes and fittings.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves judgment in determining timing of transfer of control at year-end and estimating quantity discounts payable to dealers
facts.related_party_note: There were no related party transactions entered into by the company during the financial year, which attracted the provisions of Section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013. All related party transactions are duly approved by audit committee.
